name: MONEK: Birth Of Darkness
summary: monek: the birth of darkness is a gorilla tag backrooms fan game where you and your freinds are stuck in an endless maze. the walls never change, the halls never end, and no matter how far you go, it always feels like you're going in circles. but you're not alone. you hear footsteps, but they're not yours. you hear voices, but they don't sound right. sometimes you see something move in the distance, but when you get closer, it's gone. your freinds keep getting separated. maybe the maze is shifting. maybe so
